builds.title: Sivi Amberwing, Hiveless Tosculi Rogue 2
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR
traits: Proficiency +2. Dexterity save +5 and Intelligence save +2. Natural Armor sets AC to at least 11 + Dexterity modifier.
Gliding Wings. Sivi cannot hover and takes no fall damage. Finish the round at least one-quarter of the distance flown below the start or fall. A 40 ft. glide requires a drop of at least 10 ft.
Stalker supplies Perception and Stealth. Expertise doubles the proficiency bonus for both. Sivi is proficient with thieves’ tools.

Sneak Attack deals an extra 1d6 once per turn on a hit with a finesse or ranged weapon. Sivi needs advantage or an active enemy of the target within 5 ft. of it, provided she has no disadvantage on the attack.
actions: Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack +5, range 80/320 ft. Hit 1d6 + 3 piercing.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit 1d4 + 3 piercing.
Claw. Melee attack +1, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d4 − 1 slashing.
Cunning Action. Take Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.
builds.tactics: Sivi scouts from ledge to ledge, keeping enough height to clear each gap. She calls down the route from cover before moving again.

builds.title: Narel Claywind, Earth Shaper Jinnborn Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength and Constitution saves +5. AC 14 from chain shirt and Dexterity.
Earth siraati. Narel has acid resistance. Once on his turn on a melee hit he can add 1d6 acid damage. Three uses per long rest.
Desert Dependent. Each month spent out of the desert, make a DC 15 Charisma save (−1) or gain indefinite madness as determined with the DM.
Dueling. The listed melee damage includes +2 when wielding the framing mallet in one hand with no other weapon.
actions: Framing mallet (club). Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d4 + 5 bludgeoning.
Second Wind. Bonus action to regain 1d10 + 1 HP. One use per short or long rest.
builds.tactics: Narel talks first. If pressed into a fight beside the kiln, he tries to draw the intruder away from the dry clay racks and spends his elemental strike on an opening hit.

builds.title: Vey Tern, Ramag checkpoint Wizard 1
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR
traits: Proficiency +2. Intelligence save +5 and Wisdom save +3. Arcana proficiency comes from Mystical Understanding.
Spell Damping gives advantage on Strength (−1) and Dexterity (+2) saves against spells. Arcane Heritage waives class prerequisites to attune to a magic item.

Spellcasting. Intelligence DC 13, spell attack +5. Two 1st-level slots per long rest. Arcane Recovery restores one expended 1st-level slot after a short rest, once per day. The spellbook also contains detect magic and comprehend languages, available as rituals without preparing them.
actions: Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack +1, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 − 1 bludgeoning one-handed or 1d8 − 1 with two hands.
Ray of frost (cantrip). Ranged spell attack +5, range 60 ft. Hit 1d8 cold and reduce target speed by 10 ft. through the start of Vey’s next turn.
Light or mage hand (cantrips). Light a touched object for 1 hour, or manipulate a light object in reach of a spectral hand within 30 ft. for up to 1 minute.
Mage armor (1st level). Touch a willing unarmored creature. Its base AC is 13 + Dexterity modifier for 8 hours (Vey’s AC rises to 15).
Fog cloud (1st level). A 20 ft. radius sphere within 120 ft. is heavily obscured for up to 1 hour with concentration. Wind of at least 10 mph disperses it.

Grease (1st level). Cover a 10 ft. square within 60 ft. with difficult terrain for 1 minute. Creatures in it when cast, entering it, or ending a turn there must pass a Dexterity save (DC 13) or fall prone.

Feather fall (1st level, reaction). When Vey or a creature within 60 ft. falls, choose up to five falling creatures within 60 ft. They descend at 60 ft. per round for up to 1 minute and land on their feet without fall damage if they land before the spell ends.
builds.tactics: Vey saves a spell slot for feather fall. When the upper passage closes, she guides travelers to the maintenance shaft and lowers them to the landing beneath it.

builds.title: Kesh Reedroot, Kijani trail sentinel Fighter 2
builds.difficulty: Tier 1 class-built NPC · no assigned CR
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +5 and Constitution save +4. Unarmored AC is 10 + Dexterity modifier.
Plantborn. Kesh is a Plant and is immune to effects that put a creature to sleep. Kesh rests in dormancy.
Contained Fury. At 9 HP or fewer, add 1d4 damage to one weapon hit per turn. While at 9 HP or fewer, use a reaction after an attack from a visible attacker hits to raise AC to 13 for that attack.
Dueling. The listed one-handed damage includes +2 while Kesh wields the staff with no other weapon.
actions: Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6 + 5 bludgeoning one-handed or 1d8 + 3 with two hands. Contained Fury adds 1d4 bludgeoning when eligible.
Action Surge. Take one additional action this turn. One use per short or long rest.
Second Wind. Bonus action to regain 1d10 + 2 HP. One use per short or long rest.
builds.tactics: Kesh holds the narrow crossing from the near side. Once wounded, he decides whether to hold the line with Contained Fury or heal with Second Wind and carry a warning to the next sentry.

concepts.name: Sivi Amberwing
concepts.motive: Find a way across a broken trail before the pack animals arrive.
concepts.hook: Sivi signals from the top of a waypost and asks the party to watch where she lands.

concepts.name: Narel Claywind
concepts.motive: Get a cart of clay water jars through the pass before dawn.
concepts.hook: Narel offers passage with the caravan in exchange for help bringing one late cart in from the salt flats.

concepts.name: Vey Tern
concepts.motive: Keep travelers moving while the upper passage is closed.
concepts.hook: Vey opens a hatch above a lower landing and asks who can carry the checkpoint lantern on the way down.

concepts.name: Kesh Reedroot
concepts.motive: Keep a narrow crossing open long enough for the last travelers to pass.
concepts.hook: Kesh waves the party through the crossing and asks someone to warn the next sentry that the road behind them has closed.
